description.en: Returns the figure (body type) of a character from its base data: a small number (0 to 15) that selects which motion set fits the model, e.g. data/chr/motion/game/mot_u<figure name>_gm01.xc.
Base ID (from CMND_GET_CHARABASEID), or a base ID string.

The figure number.
null if the character is not found, the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Choosing a motion file by body type (real usage, from ev47900100.nut)
